stemMarkdown: Each side of a square is increased by 45%. By what percent does its area increase? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Take the side as 100, so the area is $10000$. The new side is $145$ and the new area is $21025$. The increase is $\dfrac{11025}{10000} \times 100 = 110.25\%$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Both dimensions grow by $x\%$, so the area grows by $2x + \dfrac{x^2}{100} = 2(45) + \dfrac{2025}{100} = 110.25\%$.
